newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Camden County, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of the Borough of Runnemede
Book Entry Bonds, Bank Qualified, Callable

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary of the Board of Education at the Administrative Offices of the Board of Education, Mary E. Volz School, 505 West Third Avenue, Runnemede, New Jersey 08078, on
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the School District dated March 15, 1997 and due (subject to prior redemption) on March 15 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Board in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, N.J. The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on March 15 and September 15 in each year until maturity, commencing on September 15, 1997. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by writing to Kenneth B. Hill, the Board Secretary at 505 West Third Avenue, Runnemede, N.J. 08078, or calling (609) 931-5367.
